text:
**Apertus 1.5 8B — domain adaptation: bounded EAGLE recovery concluded.**

We tested whether updating the drafter on domain traces produces meaningful serving gains after update cost and forgetting. All **19 original curves and three preselected head confirmations** completed.

• **Multilingual: useful as a specialist.** At draft k3/C1, throughput **267→312–313 tok/s (+17% in both GPU-swapped repeats)**; median decode **3.41→2.78–2.79 ms/token**; p95 request **1.24→1.11–1.15 s**. Under load, competitive k3 gains 11–15%, with 7–14 ms extra median TTFT in some cells.
• **Summarization: C1 only.** **221→251 tok/s (+14%)**, **4.13→3.55 ms/token**, p95 **1.58→1.41 s**. C64/C256 gains fail the full benefit rule. Larger matched-k7 percentages use a weaker baseline; adapted k3 is the stronger throughput/decode choice.
• **Chat: do not implement this head.** Only ~3–8% throughput gain, with insufficient repeated decode benefit. Better development acceptance did not establish substantial serving benefit.

Selected training-loop lower bounds are **~2.0/~2.7 GPUh** for multilingual/summarization. Charging all recovery traces and all curves of each domain gives **15.8/23.9 GPUh**, amortized after **~104M/~160M output tokens** at matched k3/C1. The entire recovery used **55.47 GPUh**, including serving benchmarks and failed attempts. These are experimental/search costs, not a measured recurring production-update cost. OPB forgetting and TTFT/tail regressions prevent blanket default-head replacement.

**336 raw cells, 153,600 successful measured requests, zero failed warmups, 56 calibrated correctness gates passed.** Promotion required ≥10% throughput and decode-latency improvement in both swaps. These seeded fixed-concurrency stand-in workloads retain the original completion caps; the controls do not prove losslessness/full-answer quality. No deployment. The original conditional DSpark repeat still needs verified compatible data/port/provenance; broad #10/A3 remains open.

[Context, results and verdict](https://github.com/swiss-ai/apertus-speculative-decoding/blob/00a22fda5c9277df1233da25324377bf84e209d8/docs/drafter-updates.md) · [All absolute tradeoffs, raw measurements, configs, hashes, patches and provenance](https://github.com/swiss-ai/apertus-speculative-decoding/blob/00a22fda5c9277df1233da25324377bf84e209d8/results/8b/drafter-updates/recovery-20261030-cache/README.md).
